answer: The vertex cap is checked at intake and orchard publishes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a voyage tag. That is 34 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
